verdict.rationale: Backups and point-in-time recovery are a fair question for a backend platform with managed databases, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents automated backups or PITR. Automatic multi-region replication (docs-37) and CLI user import/export (gh-1, gh-3) are adjacent features. A community member's manual export practice (comm-16) is a user-side workaround. None of these count toward this story.
